target_customer: Corporations and financial institutions that buy carbon credits and removals and need independent sourcing, due diligence and contracting
problem: Companies buying carbon offsets lack quality information and a competitive process; Abatable offers third-party quality assessments, standardised multi-year purchase agreements and an automated RFP platform.
business_model: Procurement advisory and platform fees from buyers, plus (since the Ecosphere+ acquisition) sale of nature-based credits
product_category: Carbon markets platform / environmental asset procurement

founders.name: Maria Eugenia Filmanovic
prior_employers: Goldman Sachs (Vice President, nature-based carbon removal and offset procurement advisory)

founders.name: Valerio Magliulo
prior_employers: Facebook (global COVID-19 and vaccine misinformation lead)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Mentors at Techstars and Seedcamp.

competitors.name: Patch
competitors.what: API for buying carbon offsets and credits
competitors.traction_then: early-stage startup, figures not given in source

competitors.name: Cloverly
competitors.what: API to embed carbon offsets into checkout and product flows
competitors.traction_then: early-stage startup, figures not given in source

technical_complexity.rationale: A procurement and RFP workflow platform plus advisory research; the difficulty is domain expertise on credit quality, not software engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Expertise and relationships with developers and buyers help, but the offering is largely services and information that competitors can replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an acquirer or copy killing it; Abatable instead acquired Ecosphere+ in 2023 and remained independent through 2026.

market_need_then: Corporate net-zero pledges and the voluntary carbon market were growing in 2021 (COP26 timing), with buyers needing quality assessment and long-term procurement, as the company's seed post describes.

identity.logo: Folded ribbon forming the letter Z for zero, holding a hexagon for carbon's crystal structure (per a designer case study)

branding.brand_signature: Operating system for environmental markets positioning with a conflict-free advisory stance
branding.community_and_virality: Site shows B Corp certification and an Environmental Finance Voluntary Carbon Market Rankings 2025 win (company claim); no consumer community or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive coined name and credible B2B positioning with awards, but limited evidence beyond company-controlled pages.

pivots.to: Platform plus owned supply via Ecosphere+ acquisition
pivots.why: The company says the deal gives access to an exclusive supply of high-quality nature-based credits

outcome_analysis: Abatable raised a $3M seed in November 2021 and $13.5M from Azora Capital in April 2023, which funded the acquisition of Ecosphere+, and by 2026 claims to have supported 200+ companies. The founders' carbon-markets advisory background gave credibility, while the carbon market's volatility and the services-heavy model are the main risks.
notes: The Azora round is not labeled with a stage by either source, so stage is other; the company blog shows publication stamp 13.4.23 and a later update date while a path hints at 2024, but Carbon Credits dates it 14 April 2023. Competitors Patch and Cloverly come from a 2021 TechCrunch roundup identified through a search snippet and were not opened; their funding at the time is not recorded. Founders' education not found.
